reasoning: The study fails Node 0 Pre-Extraction Screening Gate and the Level of Analysis (LoA) Circuit Breaker. Although 73 project leaders completed surveys, the dependent variables and outcomes are aggregated at the project level (N = 73 completed NPD projects, evaluating project commercial/financial success, project duration, and team size). Under the Level of Analysis Aggregation Protocol (Screening Rule 1 & Rule 4, Extraction Rule 12), studies correlating leader BSB with project-level or firm-level aggregated outcomes constitute aggregated data and must be excluded under Code 3 to prevent cross-level ecological fallacy.
